name: sqlpath
description: SQLPath monorepo — sqlpath-backend (NestJS API) + sqlpath-frontend (Next.js). See README.md.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix sqlpath-backend && npm install --prefix sqlpath-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix sqlpath-backend" "npm run dev --prefix sqlpath-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix sqlpath-backend && npm run build --prefix sqlpath-frontend
